deal.type: Exclusive MENA commercialization partnership: partner bears all commercialization costs and pays milestones plus a high double-digit royalty on net sales
deal.source: Emmaus PR Feb 2019, https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/emmaus-life-sciences-partners-with-taiba-healthcare-to-commercialize-endari-for-sickle-cell-disease-in-the-middle-east-and-north-africa-region-300788776.html ; first early-access purchase order Dec 2019

indication.label: Reduce the acute complications of sickle cell disease in adults and children aged 5 years and older

segments.SCD: Patients with sickle cell disease and recurrent vaso-occlusive crises

indication.dosing: 5-15 g (1-3 packets of 5 g) orally twice daily by body weight; adults >= 65 kg take 3 packets twice daily
indication.mechanism: Oral amino acid thought to reduce oxidative stress in sickle red cells

label_eligible_share_override.source: Phase 3 enrolled patients with >= 2 crises in the prior year; roughly half of adult SCD patients in care meet that in Saudi cohorts (the Arab-Indian haplotype in the Eastern Province is milder), fewer in Colombia's Pacific-coast population with poorer access. One value used for both.
label_eligible_share_override.criteria: adult, >= 2 crises in the prior year

US.source: FDA approval, first SCD therapy in ~20 years

SA.note: SFDA accepted a priority-review request in April 2020 and the marketing authorization application in May 2021; a 2025 Emmaus release still lists the application as awaiting final SFDA action while NUPCO has granted market exclusivity and an early-access programme supplies GCC patients. A four-year-old dossier is modelled with a 75% probability and a mid-2027 decision.

KW.source: Emmaus 2025 release lists Kuwait, Qatar, UAE, Bahrain and Oman as approved

EU.source: EMA marketing authorization application withdrawn in 2019

CO.source: No INVIMA filing found; Colombia is outside the taiba territory and Emmaus lists no LatAm partner

SCD.primary_endpoint: Number of sickle cell crises over 48 weeks
SCD.result: Median 3 crises vs 4 on placebo (25% fewer); fewer hospitalisations (median 2 vs 3) and shorter stays
SCD.source: Niihara et al., NEJM 2018; FDA label

safety.summary: Constipation, nausea, headache, abdominal pain; no boxed warning

reference_prices.source: Emmaus operational update: WAC $1,154 per 60-packet box from Q1 2020 (up from $1,110). An adult >= 65 kg takes 6 packets/day = 36.5 boxes/yr = ~$42k; ICER's 2020 draft modelled ~$24k/yr at label-average dosing. US generic L-glutamine (ANI) launched July 2024, so the US list price is a ceiling, not a floor.
reference_prices.note: Only reference available: no EU approval (MAA withdrawn 2019); GCC prices not published

SCD.name: Hydroxyurea + supportive care (folate, analgesia, transfusion as needed)
SCD.source: Generic hydroxyurea is standard of care in both countries

SCD.name: L-glutamine (ENDARI, 6 packets of powder a day)
SCD.note: Efficacy score from a 25% reduction in median crises (3 vs 4) on top of hydroxyurea in two thirds of patients; convenience penalised for 6 powder sachets a day

SCD.name: crizanlizumab (Adakveo, monthly IV)
SCD.source: FDA 2019 on SUSTAIN (45% fewer crises); confirmatory STAND trial failed 2023 and the EU authorisation was revoked, so use is limited where still registered

SCD.name: exagamglogene autotemcel (Casgevy, one-time gene editing)
SCD.source: SFDA approval Jan 2024 for SCD >= 12y; one authorised centre so far

home_market_observed_share.source: Emmaus net revenue has run at roughly $25-30m a year against ~100,000 US SCD patients, i.e. on the order of 1% of prevalent patients on therapy seven years after approval

home_price_usd.source: Derived from the published WAC per box and adult dosing (see reference_prices)

SA.value: Endari received market exclusivity in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia through NUPCO; the marketing authorization application is awaiting final action by the SFDA; Emmaus continues to supply GCC patients through its early access program

SA: Emmaus and taiba put their Gulf effort into Saudi Arabia (priority review, NUPCO exclusivity, early access); the model also finds it the only one of the two countries worth a dedicated effort.
